James Wade is a Senior Research Scientist in Core R&D at Dow, where he works on digital transformation efforts at the intersection of chemistry, data science, and AI. His work focuses on applying machine learning and generative AI to accelerate R&D workflows, including predictive modeling, automated reporting, and deployment of agentic tools.
